printer.instructions.epson: Epson receipt printer: hold the status button on the printer for about three seconds — it prints a slip showing its current IP address. Open that address in a browser, go to "Network" or "TCP/IP", switch from "Automatic (DHCP)" to "Manual", enter the address from the manual, save, then power the printer off and on.
printer.instructions.generic: Network printer: most receipt printers print a slip with their current IP address when the feed or status button is held down while switching on. Open that address in a browser and switch the printer's network settings from "automatic" to "fixed" or "static", enter the address from the manual, save, then power the printer off and on. The exact steps are in the printer's manual.
printer.instructions.star: Star receipt printer: hold the feed button while switching the printer on — it prints a slip showing its current IP address. Open that address in a browser, under "Network configuration" switch from DHCP to "Static", enter the address from the manual, save, then power the printer off and on.

ui.setup.help.subnet: The network that the POS and the printers are on. It is on the router or in the manual. Example: 192.168.1.0/24 — meaning all addresses from 192.168.1.1 to 192.168.1.254.
